user.title: Mozillion
user.description: How do you want to sign in? Choose the browser session if Mozillion blocks automated sign-in.

credentials.title: Sign in to Mozillion
credentials.description: Mozillion will only ask for a two-factor secret next if your account needs one.

session.title: Use a browser session
session.description: Sign in to Mozillion in a browser, then copy the Cookie header and XSRF token from its developer tools.

totp.title: Two-factor secret
totp.description: Mozillion asked for a two-factor code. Paste the Base32 secret or the otpauth:// link shown when you set up your authenticator app. The integration keeps it and generates the codes itself.

manual_ids.title: Enter IDs Manually
manual_ids.description: Enter your order detail ID and SIM meta ID. Both are visible on the Mozillion dashboard's SIM selector.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Mozillion
reauth_confirm.description: Your Mozillion session has expired. Provide new credentials or a fresh cookie header.

reconfigure_confirm.title: Reconfigure Mozillion
reconfigure_confirm.description: Update the credentials or pick a different SIM to track.

reauth_totp.title: Two-factor secret
reauth_totp.description: The stored two-factor secret is missing or was rejected. Paste the Base32 secret or otpauth:// link for this account.

reconfigure_totp.title: Two-factor secret
reconfigure_totp.description: The stored two-factor secret is missing or was rejected. Paste the Base32 secret or otpauth:// link for this account.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check your credentials, cookie header and that the SIM is still on your account.
error.invalid_auth: Mozillion rejected that email or password.
error.missing_auth: Enter an email and password, or a cookie header.
error.invalid_totp: Mozillion rejected the two-factor secret. Paste the Base32 secret or otpauth:// link again.
error.cloudflare_blocked: Cloudflare is blocking sign-in from this network. Enter your FlareSolverr address below, or start again and use the browser session option.
error.solver_failed: FlareSolverr could not clear Cloudflare's challenge. Check the address, and that it runs on the same network as Home Assistant.

user.title: Add a SIM
user.description: Choose another SIM on this account to track.

manual_ids.title: Enter IDs Manually
manual_ids.description: Enter the order detail ID and SIM meta ID for the SIM. Both are visible on the Mozillion dashboard's SIM selector.

reconfigure.title: Change SIM
reconfigure.description: Pick a different SIM for this device. The device and its history are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Mozillion, or the SIM could not be confirmed. Check the connection and try again.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The Mozillion account is not running, so a SIM cannot be added. Start the integration and try again.
abort.no_new_sims: Every SIM on this account is already tracked.

dashboard_unreadable.title: Mozillion dashboard cannot be read
